info.name: ShopSpace - Phase 1 (Auth & Users)
info.description: Covers Phase 1 auth/users and Phase 2 listings, media, search, and saved listings endpoints.

item.name: Verify Account
item.description: Set the {{otpCode}} environment variable manually from the email you received before running this.

item.name: Login
item.description: Run this AFTER Verify Account succeeds. Auto-saves accessToken and refreshToken.

item.name: Google Sign-In
item.description: Paste a real Google ID token from a frontend Google OAuth flow into {{googleIdToken}} before running. This does not auto-link existing local accounts with the same email.

item.name: Refresh Token - After Logout (expect 401)
item.description: Uses the OLD refreshToken saved before logout - should now be rejected because tokenVersion changed.

item.name: Forgot Password - Unknown Email (expect 200, no leak)
Reset Password
item.description: Update {{otpCode}} with the NEW code from the Forgot Password email before running.

item.name: Add Landlord Role
item.description: Adds a role idempotently and returns fresh access/refresh tokens because roles affect authorization.

item.name: Set Active Role
item.description: Switches UI preference only. Run Add Landlord Role first, otherwise this should fail validation in the service.

item.name: Link Google Account
item.description: Paste a real Google ID token from a frontend Google OAuth flow into {{googleIdToken}} before running. This is the only endpoint that links Google to an existing local account.

item.name: Update Password
item.description: Assumes password was already reset to {{newPassword}} earlier in the flow. Sets it back to {{password}}.

item.name: Delete Me
item.description: Destructive - run this LAST. Deletes the test account entirely.
